# RuleBuilderContext

[API index](../index)

Configure a timer or hotkey rule; fluent methods update and return the same builder.
Attach `.Do(...)` to supply the action; `.If(...)`, `.Cooldown(...)` and `.Group(...)` constrain firing.

**@keywords**

rules, builder, scheduling, predicate, action

## If

```typescript
If(predicate: () => boolean): this;
```

Gate the rule on a predicate; last call wins. Sleep is allowed and keeps this rule busy
through the predicate and action. Other rules remain independent while this predicate waits.

**@keywords**

rules, predicate, condition, filter

## Cooldown

```typescript
Cooldown(cooldown_ms: number): this;
```

Set a minimum interval (ms) between fires; the cooldown arms when the rule fires.

**Parameter `cooldown_ms`**

Cooldown in milliseconds; non-positive or non-finite values disable it.

**@keywords**

rules, cooldown, throttle, rate limit

## Group

```typescript
Group(group: GroupScope | string): this;
```

Bind the rule to a group handle or name. A disabled group suppresses the rule.

**@keywords**

rules, groups, enable, disable

## Do

```typescript
Do(action: () => unknown): this;
```

Set the action; last call wins. Sleep and returned Promises keep this rule busy until completion.
Rule context survives waits. Stop abandons automation-owned continuations without JS finally;
the host releases held input. A rule without Do never fires.

**@keywords**

rules, action, callback, execute

## Panic

```typescript
Panic(): this;
```

Keep this hotkey eligible while automation is disabled or the game window is in the background.
Press-edge, hotkey-scope and group checks still apply; keep an emergency stop ungrouped.

While inactive, applied commands are limited to `Input.KeyUp`/`Input.ReleaseAll`, behavior
setters with `false`, `Automation.SetEnabled(false)`, and OSD drawing/clearing. Other queued
commands are dropped. Group operations act directly; `DisableAllGroups()` can also suppress
grouped panic hotkeys. This does not grant unrestricted input or background automation.

**@throws**

Calling this on a timer rule throws during registration.

**Example**

```ts
OnHotkey("F8", HotkeyScope.Global).Panic().Do(() => World.Input.ReleaseAll());
```

**@keywords**

panic, emergency stop, kill switch, cleanup, background
